newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian UGB, Hoogovens still in talks.
newsitem.headline: Belgian UGB, Hoogovens still in talks.

text.p: Belgian privately-held steel firm Usines Gustave Boel (UGB), in talks with the Dutch metals group Hoogovens over a joint venture, said on Wednesday there was no final agreement yet with the Dutch group.
"We have not yet finalised an agreement with Hoogovens," Boel spokesman Pierre Stievenart told Reuters.
"Our objective is to conclude an agreement by the end of December 1996," Stievenart added.

Sepearately, Hoogovens said "good progress" was being made on the eventual joint venture but confirmed that they had not completed any deal. Earlier this month Hoogovens said it hoped a deal would be completed by the end of the year.
The two companies announced in October they had agreed to work on the formation of a 50/50 pertnership for the recapitalisation of Boel.

Earlier on Wednesday Boel and Belgium's largest steel maker, Cockerill Sambre said in a joint statement that they had abandoned a possible partnership plan because of an "absence of complementary aspects and worthwile economic synergies between the two companies".

"We (Cockerill and Boel) agree that a joint venture between Boel and Hoogovens would be better for both Boel and Hoogovens (than a Cockerill-Boel link up)," Cockerill's chief executive officer Philippe Delaunois told Reuters.
